about.text: A very fresh, creamy goat's cheese of 100 to 200 g, made from raw whole goat's milk by lactic (acid) coagulation in many provinces of Lombardy. It is unpressed and takes up to 36 hours to set; a thin mould rind may form on short ageing.

sources.text: The milk, the lactic set, the size and the ageing, from the regional sheet.
